say:19:1360209020:0.source_cn: 在一阵狂笑声中，贝利尔的身影缓缓消散在空气中。

say:21:1360209021:0.source_cn: 几乎在他消散的同时，顿里尔随着一道金光出现在了你们面前……

say:22:1360209022:0.text: Again, I'm one step behind. He always bolts at the last minute when he could have left earlier—I'm quite sure he's doing this on purpose.
say:22:1360209022:0.source_cn: 果然又迟了一步。那家伙应该是故意的，明明可以提前逃跑，...

say:23:1360209023:0.text: That's too much! Is he trying to mess with a Celestial?!
say:23:1360209023:0.source_cn: 太嚣张了，他是想用这种恶作剧挑衅半神吗！

say:25:1360209025:1.text: Anyway, we should rescue your friend first.

say:40:1360211009:1.source_cn: 当时我听到的，是你被偷袭而后交战，同时还捕捉到了扭曲的气息。

say:41:1360211010:1.source_cn: 风语者啊，你们的能力我也久仰大名了。

say:50:1360211019:1.text: I put on an ignorant face, but when I probed him, he suddenly erupted into wild laughter.
say:50:1360211019:1.source_cn: 我装作没有发现异常，试探对方的时候，对方却突然狂笑起来。

say:52:1360211021:1.text: Then we got here. Phew, I'm glad you weren't hurt!
say:52:1360211021:1.source_cn: 接下来就是我们抵达此处了，呼，太好了，还好你没受伤。

narration:69:1360212002:0.source_cn: 悦耳的琴音缭绕在森林周围，法拉莫尔突然露出了如梦方醒的神色。

say:72:1360213001:1.text: Wait a minute! I think my doppelganger said something before I passed out!
say:72:1360213001:1.source_cn: 我想起来了，在我被暗影包裹，即将失去意识之前，我听到扮...

say:75:1360213003:1.text: Ah... I'm not important. Who YOU are is what truly matters, don't you think, fluffy white guy?
say:75:1360213003:1.source_cn: 啊——我是什么不重要，你是什么才比较重要吧，毛茸茸的大...

say:76:1360213004:1.text: I thought you were a Mauler... Do you have any idea how fascinating those guys are?
say:76:1360213004:1.source_cn: 我还以为你会是蛮血那边的呢……真是的，你知不知道那边的...

say:77:1360213005:1.text: They're a bunch of blockheads who only know how to throw punches. Just drop them the tiniest clue, and they'll jump on it.
say:77:1360213005:1.source_cn: 他们没脑子、傻乎乎，只知道打架，稍微给一点小线索就会上钩——

say:80:1360213008:1.text: Ah!!! This doesn't make any sense!
say:80:1360213008:1.source_cn: 啊啊啊啊啊，不合理，不合理！

say:82:1360213009:1.text: That fellow started talking to himself. He was laughing at first, but the next moment, he flew into a rage...
say:82:1360213009:1.source_cn: 那家伙自言自语，一开始笑，但转眼间就开始大怒……

say:83:1360213010:1.text: The last thing I heard before blacking out was his scream.
say:83:1360213010:1.source_cn: 在我失去意识前，还能听到他的尖叫。

say:85:1360213011:0.text: Well, Berial's mood swings are just as notorious as his madness.
say:85:1360213011:0.source_cn: 的确，贝利尔的喜怒无常和他的癫狂同样有名。
